opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search sorted by price
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights from {origin} to {destination} ({trip_type}, {depart_date}–{return_date}) and sort results by lowest price, optionally showing points.
steps: Type the origin in 'From' and pick the matching suggestion
Type the destination in 'To' and pick the matching suggestion
If one-way, change 'Roundtrip' to 'One-way'
Pick the depart date (and return date if roundtrip) in the calendar
Click 'Search flights', then 'Continue to flight results' if prompted
Open 'Sort & Filter', optionally choose fare type (Points)
Change sort from 'Default' to price low-to-high and click 'Apply'
Optionally open 'Details' on a flight

instances.values: New York → Miami, roundtrip, 27–31, Points, sort 'Price by Core'
New York → Toronto, one-way, depart 29, sort Price (low to high), opened Details
NYC → Aruba (AUA), roundtrip 1 → Fri May 5 2023, sort Price (low to high); interrupted by Budget Fastbreak signup

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: Search United car rentals at {pickup_location} from {pickup_date} to {dropoff_date}, with optional pickup/drop-off times and pay-with-miles.
steps: Click the 'CAR' tab
Optionally check 'Book with miles'
Type the pickup location and pick the matching suggestion
Open the 'Pickup' date picker and choose pickup and drop-off dates
Optionally set pickup time and drop-off time
Click 'Find cars'

instances.values: Caldwell, Apr 8–13 2023, 8:00 a.m. pickup / 12:00 p.m. drop-off, book with miles
Brooklyn - Central (New York), Apr 9–15 2023, default times, cash

opportunities.name: Budget careers job opening search
opportunities.description: Filter Budget job openings by {country}, {team} and {time_type}, then optionally open a posting and click Apply.
steps: Click 'Careers', then 'Openings'
Open the 'Country' filter, search, and select the country
Open the 'Team' filter, search, and select the team
Open the 'Time Type' filter, search, and select the time type
Click 'SEARCH BY JOB TITLE OR KEYWORD'
Optionally open a job posting and click 'APPLY NOW'

instances.values: United States of America / Finance / Full time; opened 'Accounts Payable Associate' and clicked Apply
United States of America / Finance / Full time; search only

opportunities.name: Product search with max price and add to cart
opportunities.description: Search a retailer for {query}, cap the price at {max_price}, and add a result to the cart.
steps: Type the query in the site search box and submit
Type the maximum price in the price filter and click 'GO'/'Go'
Optionally apply another filter (e.g. rating)
Open the chosen product if needed
Click 'Add to Cart'

instances.values: Menards: 'swivel vacuum', max $150, add first result to cart
Amazon: 'wireless headphones', max $100, extra filter, added EAORUL ANC headphones to cart

opportunities.name: NPS find parks by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, find parks filtered by {filter_type} (Activity or Topic) and the selected {values}.
steps: Click 'FIND A PARK'
Click 'Search by Activity or Topic'
Open the 'Activity' or 'Topic' dropdown
Check the desired option(s)
Click 'Search'

opportunities.name: MTA bridge & tunnel toll lookup by vehicle type
opportunities.description: Look up MTA Bridges & Tunnels toll rates for {vehicle_type}.
steps: Go to Fares & Tolls → Bridges and Tunnels tolls → Toll Rates (or Menu → Agencies → Bridges & Tunnels → Tolls by vehicle)
Select the vehicle type
Expand the crossing of interest
